name: fileOpen
description: Opens an file to read, write, or append.
syntax: fileOpen( string file, [string mode], [string charset], [boolean seekable] )

params.name: mode
params.description:
Action to perform on the file, including the following:

- read
- readBinary
- write
- append

If you do not specify the mode, Lucee opens the file in read mode.

params.name: charset
params.description: The character set of the file.

params.name: seekable
params.description: can be used for function fileseek
